content:
maria.partnerships: FYI — Partner X asked to include a short SOC2 excerpt in the joint launch blog. They want a screenshot of the high-level report summary and a callout that we’re SOC2-compliant. Thoughts?

sam.security: We can include a high-level excerpt but not raw control IDs or auditor comments. Need redaction + signed attestation from Partner X. Also confirm they’ve given permission for quoting the report. :eyes:

anya.legal: We need a redaction template and partner attestation signed by an authorized signee. No raw report PDFs in public S3. If they insist, legal review + PR restriction. Also check if BAA/DPAs cover sharing.

lee.eng-privacy: For redaction, we usually strip control IDs and vendor notes. Example redaction rule we use: `s/Control ID:.*|Auditor Notes:.*//g` — can do automated scrub before creating the screenshot. Also: presigned artifacts should expire quickly (default 24h).

harry.si: On the SI side — SI integrators need the marketplace listing checklist filled before we publish. They also requested to witness the pen test window (they want to join remotely). We should lock a 2-week pen window and presign artifacts for witness reviewers.

sam.security: Pen test witnessing ok but control: do not expose raw logs or off-target scope. We provide a sanitized findings summary and redact PII/IP prior to sharing. For presign: 48h maximum unless legal approves longer.

maria.partnerships: Proposed schedule: announcement target 2026-04-12. Pen test witness window 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-14. Draft excerpt + redaction by 2026-04-05. Legal signoff by 2026-04-09. Partner attestation needed by 2026-04-04. Does that work?

anya.legal: Timeline is tight but doable. We'll need the attestation doc template — I can drop one. Also flag: marketing quote must be pre-approved by partner legal.

lee.eng-privacy: I'll add an automated scrub job to the pipeline. Quick snippet for presign command we'll use:```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/partnerX/soc-summary.pdf --expires-in 172800
```Set to 48h by default.

sam.security: Note: set audit trail for who downloaded presigned artifacts. Add CloudTrail + internal access log retention 90d.

harry.si: I'll fill the SI questionnaire today and send over a delta plan for integration security gating. Can we get a link to the marketing draft once legal edits are in?

maria.partnerships: Yes — I'll post the draft in this thread and ping everyone. Action items: (1) Anya: attestation template and legal checklist by EOD, (2) Lee: scrub job + presign config, (3) Sam: sanitized findings summary template + audit logs config, (4) Harry: SI questionnaire + witness logistics. I'll coordinate partner signoff.

deploy-bot: listing-pipeline: status -> staging (skeleton listing created for partnerX) :rocket: 

maria.partnerships: Thanks everyone — will follow up with doc links. (cc @sam.security @anya.legal)
